data.name: Certificates
data.value: Client certificates

data.name: CertificateGuidance
data.value: This authored section can contain localized content, partial views and GC components. For services requiring mutual TLS, provide the client certificate alongside the access token. The command below is illustrative.

data.name: RateLimits
data.value: Rate limits

data.name: RateLimitGuidance
data.value: This sample service allows 60 requests per minute per organization. When a response returns HTTP 429, wait for the number of seconds in Retry-After before retrying.

data.name: Support
data.value: Integration support

data.name: SupportGuidance
data.value: Use sections after the API reference for onboarding instructions, change history or support contacts. The specification is shown in its original language; the component labels follow the page language.

data.name: Purpose
data.value: Present an API contract and its integration guidance using the GCFoundation layout. The OpenAPI document supplies the reference; authored Razor sections explain service-specific requirements.

data.name: WhenUse1
data.value: Publish a readable reference from an OpenAPI 3.x JSON document.

data.name: WhenUse2
data.value: Combine endpoint details with certificate setup, onboarding, rate limits or support instructions.

data.name: WhenNot1
data.value: An interactive API console is required. This component displays documentation and does not send requests.

data.name: WhenNot2
data.value: The source is YAML, Swagger 2 or an unbundled document with external Reference Objects. Convert or bundle it first.

data.name: Accessibility1
data.value: Give the page a heading and each authored section a clear, localized title. Use appropriate heading levels within the section.

data.name: Accessibility2
data.value: Set stable, unique component and section IDs so navigation and deep links remain usable when content is translated.

data.name: Accessibility3
data.value: Add tabindex="0" to authored code blocks and provide meaningful link text. Check keyboard scrolling and the layout at narrow widths.

data.name: AccessibilityNot
data.value: Do not rely on HTTP method colours alone or hide essential guidance in examples. Keep all required instructions available as text.

data.name: Ux1
data.value: Keep the source specification current and provide a download link to the same version.

data.name: Ux2
data.value: Place setup guidance before the reference and support information after it. Use the full-width demo to assess long documents in their intended page layout.

data.name: BasicTitle
data.value: OpenAPI reference

data.name: BasicText
data.value: Load the JSON in a controller or service and pass its contents through your view model. The component renders metadata, parameters, request bodies, responses, examples, authentication and linked schemas. Open the demonstration to see the complete reference in the GC shell.

data.name: OpenDemo
data.value: Open the API documentation demo

data.name: BackToDocs
data.value: Back to the page template guide

data.name: CustomTitle
data.value: Custom specification sections

data.name: CustomText
data.value: Add sections containing Razor markup, partial views or GC components. Sections appear before the generated reference by default; after-endpoints places them after the reference and its schemas. Omit document entirely to create an authored guide.

data.name: NoteAssets
data.value: The standard foundation.min.css and foundation.min.js bundles include this component. Content and anchor navigation remain available without JavaScript.

data.name: NoteLocalization
data.value: Labels follow the current UI culture in English or French. Supply translated specification text and authored content separately. OpenAPI descriptions are encoded plain text; Markdown is not rendered.

data.name: NoteLoading
data.value: The helper does not read files, fetch URLs or execute API calls. The application loads the JSON and serves the optional download. Malformed JSON, unsupported versions and broken Reference Objects throw during rendering.

data.name: NoteSchemas
data.value: Recursive schemas and constraints are preserved as JSON; reusable schemas are linked rather than expanded recursively. Callbacks, webhooks and links do not yet have dedicated generated sections.

data.name: PropDocument
data.value: OpenAPI 3.x JSON contents. Omit for authored sections only.

data.name: PropId
data.value: Unique anchor prefix. Generated when omitted; provide a stable value for deep links. Use ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

data.name: PropTitle
data.value: Contents navigation title. Defaults to info.title from the document.

data.name: PropDownload
data.value: Optional HTTP(S) or application-relative download link. Use Url.Content to respect the application's path base.

data.name: PropSectionTitle
data.value: Required section heading and navigation label. Localize it in the calling view.

data.name: PropSectionId
data.value: Stable section suffix. The generated anchor is {parent-id}-section-{child-id}; punctuation is normalized and duplicates are deduplicated.

data.name: PropAfter
data.value: Place the section after the entire generated reference, including schemas.

data.name: TemplateIntro
data.value: A complete API documentation page with contents navigation, setup guidance, an OpenAPI reference and specification downloads.

data.name: TemplateImplementation
data.value: Use the standard Foundation layout and a page heading. The fdcp-api-docs helper composes the page body: overview, downloads, authored sections and contents navigation. It delegates generated API details to the same renderer used by fdcp-api-reference.

data.name: TemplateCodeTitle

data.name: ReferenceOverview
data.value: Render operations, parameters, request bodies, responses, authentication and schemas from OpenAPI JSON within an existing page.

data.name: ReferencePurpose
data.value: Provide reusable API reference content independently of the page layout. This renderer also powers the API documentation page template.

data.name: ReferenceWhenUse
data.value: Embed an API reference in an existing page that already provides its own heading and navigation.

data.name: ReferenceWhenNot
data.value: For a complete developer documentation page with custom guidance, contents navigation and downloads, use the API documentation page template.
